simple.meaning: זְמָן (zᵉmân) is a Hebrew object word meaning “season, time.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Ezra 5:3. The surrounding context includes family line, Torah, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זְמָן (H2166) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: זְמָן (zᵉmân) / H2166 is traced through Ezra 5:3, Daniel 2:16, Daniel 2:21, Daniel 3:7 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: At the same time Tattenai, the governor beyond the River came to them, with Shetharbozenai, and their companions, and asked them, “Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?”

timeline.evidenceText: At the same time Tattenai, the governor beyond the River came to them, with Shetharbozenai, and their companions, and asked them, “Who gave you a decree to build this house, and to finish this wall?”
Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.
He changes the times and the seasons.

Therefore at that time, when all the peoples heard the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, all the peoples, the nations, and the languages, fell down and worshiped the golden image that Nebuchadnezzar the king had set up.
Therefore at that time certain Chaldeans came near, and brought accusation against the Jews.

This was fulfilled the same hour on Nebuchadnezzar. He was driven from men, and ate grass as oxen, and his body was wet with the dew of the sky, until his hair had grown like eagles’ feathers, and his nails like birds’ claws.
Then these men assembled together, and found Daniel making petition and supplication before his God.
Then the king, when he heard these words, was very displeased, and set his heart on Daniel to deliver him; and he labored until the going down of the sun to rescue him.
As for the rest of the animals, their dominion was taken away; yet their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.
until the ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the Most High, and the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.

He will speak words against the Most High, and will wear out the saints of the Most High. He will plan to change the times and the law; and they will be given into his hand until a time and times and half a time.

definitions.full: H2166. zeman זְמַן noun masculine Dan 3:7 time (probably loan-word from Old Persian zrvan, zarvâna , time , age , Nö M 152 Scheft 45 ; compare Biblical Hebrew (late); and (on change of ν [ b ] to m ) Frä ZA iii. 52 ; Nabataean זמן , Palmyrene (Nabataean) זבן Lzb 266 ; Lzb 268 SAC 48. 49 ); — absolute ׳ז 2:16 ; 7:12 ; emphatic זִמְנָא Ezra 5:3 +; plural absolute Dan 6:11 +, emphatic זִמְנַיָּא 2:21 ; — time: specified time 2:16 ; appointed time 7:12 , 22 , compare 2:21 ; זִמְנָא בֵּהּ at that time Ezra 5:3 ; Dan 3:7-8 , 4:33 ; (festival) seasons 7:25 ; time, occurrence , 6:11 ; 6:14 three times in the day.
